# ebay-mcp

> A local Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI assistants 379 tools for the eBay Sell, Commerce and Developer APIs. It runs on your machine with your own eBay keys and has no cloud relay. Unofficial project, not affiliated with or endorsed by eBay Inc.

Built with TypeScript, the MCP SDK and Zod tool inputs. Supports OAuth 2.0, the legacy Trading API, configurable tool exposure and optional MCP Apps views. Works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, Zed, Continue.dev, Roo Code, Amazon Q Developer and any MCP client.

## Install

- Get a Client ID, Client Secret and RuName from the [eBay Developer Portal](https://developer.ebay.com/my/keys).
- Run `npm install -g ebay-mcp`, then `npx ebay-mcp setup`. The wizard saves credentials, runs OAuth and configures your MCP client. Needs Node.js 24 or newer.
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add ebay --env EBAY_CLIENT_ID=... --env EBAY_CLIENT_SECRET=... --env EBAY_ENVIRONMENT=sandbox -- npx -y ebay-mcp`

## Configuration

- `EBAY_CLIENT_ID`, `EBAY_CLIENT_SECRET`, `EBAY_REDIRECT_URI`, `EBAY_USER_REFRESH_TOKEN`: eBay credentials.
- `EBAY_ENVIRONMENT`: `sandbox` (default) or `production`.
- `EBAY_MCP_TOOLS`: `all` (default), `dynamic`, or a comma-separated list of the family keys below.
- `EBAY_READ_ONLY`: `true` registers only read-only tools.
- `EBAY_MCP_UI`: `off` turns the interactive MCP Apps views off.
- `EBAY_MCP_MEDIA_DIRS`, `EBAY_MCP_MEDIA_ROOT`: directories local upload tools may read. Off until set.
- Full list: [.env.example](https://github.com/YosefHayim/ebay-mcp/blob/main/.env.example)

## Tool families

Each key is a valid `EBAY_MCP_TOOLS` value. This list is generated by `pnpm readme:tools`.

<!-- tool-families:start -->
- `connector`: Connector, 2 tools
- `token-management`: Token Management, 10 tools
- `account`: Account, 51 tools
- `finances`: Finances, 11 tools
- `inventory`: Inventory, 49 tools
- `feed`: Feed, 23 tools
- `stores`: Stores, 8 tools
- `fulfillment`: Fulfillment, 17 tools
- `logistics`: Logistics, 6 tools
- `marketing`: Marketing, 81 tools
- `analytics`: Analytics, 4 tools
- `metadata`: Metadata, 27 tools
- `taxonomy`: Taxonomy, 8 tools
- `communication`: Communication, 33 tools
- `browse`: Browse, 2 tools
- `other`: Other, 34 tools
- `developer`: Developer, 7 tools
- `trading`: Trading, 6 tools
<!-- tool-families:end -->
